crossRefs.note: “Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last…
Yahweh of Armies says: “The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together. All who took them…
“I have forsaken my house. I have cast off my heritage. I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her…
for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger…
All you animals of the field, come to devour, all you animals in the forest.
Israel was holiness to Yahweh, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him will be held guilty. Evil will come…
The captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said to him, “Yahweh your God pronounced this evil on this place;
and Yahweh has brought it, and done according as he spoke. Because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed…
I was angry with my people. I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no mercy. You laid…
We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers…
Lord, according to all your righteousness, let your anger and please let your wrath be turned away from your city…
I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”
Their buyers slaughter them, and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, for I am rich;’ and their…
Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Yet again they will use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities…
Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring…
Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope;

translations.web: All who found them have devoured them. Their adversaries said, ‘We are not guilty, because they have sinned against Yahweh, the habitation of righteousness, even Yahweh, the hope of their fathers.’
translations.bsb: All who found them devoured them, and their enemies said, ‘We are not guilty, for they have sinned against the LORD, their true pasture, the LORD, the hope of their fathers.’
translations.kjv: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
translations.asv: All that found them have devoured them; and their adversaries said, We are not guilty, because they have sinned against Jehovah, the habitation of righteousness, even Jehovah, the hope of their fathers.
